high_level_description: The image shows an open book with the page titled "INTRODUCTION." The text on the page discusses the history and significance of TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company), a major player in the semiconductor industry. It mentions Morris Chang, the founder of TSMC, who played a crucial role in establishing Taiwan as a global center for semiconductor manufacturing. The text highlights the geopolitical tensions surrounding Taiwan, noting that Beijing has not ruled out the possibility of invading Taiwan to reunify it with the mainland.
